annotation.title_clean: Compliance with Data Protection Regulations in Wake of Growing AI Regulations
annotation.title_en: Compliance with Data Protection Regulations in Wake of Growing AI Regulations
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC), Kenya
annotation.summary_en: News release from Kenya's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner on remarks at the Law Society of Kenya conference. The Commissioner urges ethical AI use and data protection compliance, including DPIAs, data subject rights and safeguards, when processing personal data with AI. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI raises privacy challenges: increased data collection, lack of informed consent, unauthorised data use for model training
Assess whether AI processing falls within data protection law before starting
Conduct DPIAs where necessary and implement technical and organisational safeguards
Legal practitioners should embed data protection in client governance structures
